acceptance: Each non-passed cell in a release UAT artifact names its failed queries and their errors.
context:
Evidence: release-v2 run 40971306663 (tag v0.5.0rc2, commit b1459438d), for example artifact release-uat-v0.5.0rc2-stage1-sqlite, per-cell log sqlite_nyctaxi_0.01_*.log, whose failure tail holds only the result path.

Hosted trunk UAT run https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/BenchBox/actions/runs/42536258036 completed with failure at source 2d796acd59be06ab4b4a1742dda84cff419202b9. The retained stage1-duckdb and stage3-olap artifacts include cells.jsonl with failed_query_details and per-cell diagnostic logs. Those retained details exposed DuckDB’s duplicate struct-field conversion error and SingleStore/Doris memory errors. Evidence is now sufficient to diagnose these current failures without a rerun. Counts cover the selected current matrix only; no historical issue is closed by this note. The full run is still red (702/710 passed), so this is not release certification.
description: For query_failure cells the shard artifact's failure tail is just the result JSON path on the runner; the result JSON is not uploaded. In run 40971306663 more than 100 failed cells cannot be diagnosed without a rerun. Upload result JSON, or at least the failed query IDs and error messages, for every non-passed cell.
